# Recycled Records LP — Boulder, Colorado

> Recycled Records LP is a used and new vinyl record store in Boulder, Colorado (Gunbarrel). One of Colorado's largest selections of vinyl records, CDs, cassettes, and vintage audio. Every used record is ultrasonically cleaned before hitting the floor. We buy and sell music collections.

## About

Recycled Records LP is a community-driven record store with one of Colorado's most extensive selections of new and used vinyl records and compact discs. The store has operated since 2010, originally in Longmont and relocated to Gunbarrel (Boulder) in April 2026. Owner: Gale Taylor.

- [Home](https://recycledrecordslps.com)
- [Shop Online](https://recycledrecordslps.com/shop)
- [Sell Your Records](https://recycledrecordslps.com/sell)

## What We Sell

Recycled Records LP carries over 100,000 vinyl records and 20,000 used CDs. Every used record is ultrasonically cleaned using a Clear Audio Double Matrix Ultrasonic Cleaner and inspected before going on the floor. Inventory is organized by genre and alphabetized by artist.

**Genres:** Rock, Jazz, Soul & Blues, Hip-Hop, Electronic, Pop, Classical, Country & Folk, Metal, Punk, Indie, Children's, Spoken Word, Rare & Collectible pressings.

**Formats:** Vinyl records (new and used), CDs, cassettes, DVDs, vintage audio equipment, turntables, receivers, movie posters and memorabilia.

## Buying & Selling

We buy used vinyl records, CDs, cassettes, and vintage audio equipment. We accept collections of all sizes including estate sales — no appointment needed. We also buy rare and collectible pressings. Submit a sell inquiry with photos at recycledrecordslps.com/sell.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where is Recycled Records LP located?**
Recycled Records LP is at 6565 Gunpark Dr, Suite 190, Boulder, CO 80301 (Gunbarrel area). The store relocated from Longmont to Boulder in April 2026.

**What are your hours?**
Tuesday–Friday 11am–6pm, Saturday 10am–6pm, Sunday 11am–6pm. Closed Mondays.

**Do you buy records?**
Yes. We buy vinyl records, CDs, cassettes, and vintage audio equipment. Collections of all sizes accepted — including estate sales. No appointment needed. You can also submit a sell inquiry online at recycledrecordslps.com/sell.

**How many records do you have?**
Over 100,000 vinyl records and 20,000+ CDs in stock. One of the largest selections in Colorado.

**Are the used records cleaned?**
Yes. Every used record is ultrasonically cleaned using a Clear Audio Double Matrix Ultrasonic Cleaner before it goes on the floor. We also inspect and grade each record.

**Can I buy records online?**
Yes. Browse and purchase at recycledrecordslps.com/shop. Records ship from Boulder, CO.

**Do you carry new vinyl?**
Yes — we stock both new and used vinyl records.

**What genres do you carry?**
Rock, Jazz, Soul & Blues, Hip-Hop, Electronic, Pop, Classical, Country & Folk, Metal, Punk, Indie, Children's, Spoken Word, and Rare & Collectible pressings.

**Are you on Discogs?**
Yes. Our Discogs seller profile is RecycledRecordsLp with 4,500+ listings.

**Where did the old Longmont location go?**
The store relocated from Longmont to Boulder (Gunbarrel) in April 2026. The new address is 6565 Gunpark Dr, Suite 190, Boulder, CO 80301.
